user.title: Connect to your Codie
user.description: Enter the address of your Codie. You can find its IP address in your router. The Codie must be awake and signed in.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of the Codie.
data_description.port: The port of the Codie's local API. Leave at 8081 unless you changed it.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add the Codie found on your network
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant found a Codie at {host}. The Codie must be awake and signed in. Select Submit to make it show a pairing code.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with your Codie again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer sign in to the Codie at {host}. This happens when another user signs in on the Codie, or its pairing was reset. Select Submit to make the Codie show a new pairing code.

pair.title: Pair with your Codie
pair.description: Your Codie is now showing a six-digit pairing code. Enter it below. The code is valid for 5 minutes.

data_description.code: The six-digit code shown on the Codie's screen.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Codie. Check the host and port, and that the Codie is awake.
error.invalid_code: That code is not correct. Check the code on the Codie and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while pairing. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Codie is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Codie. Check the host and port, and that the Codie is awake.
abort.code_expired: The pairing code expired or was already used. Start again to get a new code.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error while pairing. See the Home Assistant log for details.
abort.reauth_successful: Pairing worked again. The Codie is back online.
abort.wrong_device: This is a different Codie from the one that was set up. Check the host, or add it as a new Codie.
abort.not_ipv4_address: The Codie announced an IPv6 address. Home Assistant reaches the Codie over IPv4; add it with its IPv4 address instead.
abort.not_signed_in: No user is signed in on the Codie. Sign in on the device, then try again.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Makes the Character speak a message, word for word or in its own words.

message.name: Message
message.description: What the Character says, word for word. Up to 16000 characters.

queue.name: Queue
queue.description: Wait until the Character is idle, then speak the message and save it to its chat history. Up to 200 characters. Leave off to speak at once, cutting off whatever the Character is doing. Cannot be combined with In character.

in_character.name: In character
in_character.description: Let the Character say the message in its own words and personality, as a short announcement, instead of word for word. It starts after about 8 seconds, cuts off whatever the Character is doing, and spends some of the Codie's token quota. If the Character cannot say it, the message is spoken as given. Up to 15000 characters.

instructions.name: Instructions
instructions.description: How the Character should say it, such as "sound urgent" or "keep it under 10 words". Up to 500 characters. Needs In character.

remember.name: Remember
remember.description: Save the exchange to the Character's chat history, where it shows as if you had said the instruction. Leave off to save nothing. Needs In character.

announcement_length.message: The message must have between 1 and {max} characters.

instructions_length.message: The instructions must have at most {max} characters.

in_character_required.message: Instructions and Remember only work together with In character.

in_character_not_queued.message: An announcement in character cannot be queued: it is always said at once.

codie_target_missing.message: Choose a Codie as the target: add a target and pick the Codie device or its Announce entity.

codie_not_loaded.message: That Codie is not loaded. Check its status on the Codie integration page.

announce_blocked.message: The Codie cannot speak right now ({reason}). It may be asleep or locked; wake it first.

announce_cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Codie. Check that it is awake and on the network.

announce_auth_failed.message: The Codie no longer accepts Home Assistant. Pair it again from the integration page.

announce_not_ready.message: The Codie's speech service is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.

setting_cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Codie. Check that it is awake and on the network.

setting_auth_failed.message: The Codie no longer accepts Home Assistant. Pair it again from the integration page.

setting_not_confirmed.message: The Codie received the change but could not confirm it: {error}

setting_music_volume_failed.message: The Codie could not set the Music volume: {error}

music_command_failed.message: The Codie could not run the music command: {error}

music_command_not_confirmed.message: The Codie received the music command but did not confirm it ran: {error}

music_mode_inactive.message: The Codie is not in Music mode. Open its music player on the Codie first; only the volume works without it.

character_unknown.message: The Codie has no Character called {option}. Its Characters may have changed; try again.

clock_skew.title: The clocks of {name} and Home Assistant differ
clock_skew.description: {name} rejects Home Assistant's requests because the time on Home Assistant and the time on the Codie are more than 5 minutes apart. Every request is signed with the time. Check that both show the correct time: that network time (NTP) works on the machine running Home Assistant, and that the Codie is online. This issue goes away once a request works again.

catalog_rejected.title: {name} refused the Tools
catalog_rejected.description: {name} refused the Tools that Home Assistant offers its Character ({error}), so the Character cannot control your home. Check for an update of the integration or of the Codie's software. If it keeps happening, report it with the error above. This issue goes away once the Codie accepts the Tools.

core_tool_missing.title: {name} has no {tool} Tool
core_tool_missing.description: The Character on {name} cannot use the `{tool}` Tool, because Home Assistant has no `{assist_tool}` Assist tool. Home Assistant provides it itself, so Assist is not fully set up. Make sure the Conversation integration is loaded: Assist should work under Settings → Voice assistants. If this issue persists after a Home Assistant upgrade, report it. This issue goes away once the Tool is offered.

tool_unsupported.title: {name} has no {tool} Tool
tool_unsupported.description: The Character on {name} cannot use the `{tool}` Tool, because the parameters of Home Assistant's `{assist_tool}` Assist tool don't fit the Codie's limits: {error}. This can happen after a Home Assistant upgrade; check for an update of the integration. This issue goes away once the Tool is offered.
